newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden endorses EU move to recall Iran ambasssadors.
newsitem.headline: Sweden endorses EU move to recall Iran ambasssadors.

text.p: Sweden on Friday backed a European Union suggestion that member countries recall their ambassadors from Iran "for consultations".

The EU said there was no basis to continue "critical dialogue" with Iran after a German court on Thursday accused Iranian leaders of ordering the killing of exiled Kurdish dissidents in Berlin. Iran rejected the ruling.

"We take the German court ruling very seriously and we approve of EU countries together showing what we think about the Iranian situation," Annika Soder, spokeswoman at the Foreign Ministry, told Reuters.

Soder said Iran has been much debated in Sweden with strong condemnation of its death sentence, or fatwa, on British author Salman Rushdie in 1989 and its recent imprisoning of Iranian writer Faraj Sarkoohi.
